leadText: Shogakukan Asia Pte. Ltd. (Japanese: 小学館アジア Shōgakukan Asia) is an English language manga and children's book publisher based in . They are an official subsidiary of the Japanese publisher Shogakukan. Their books are available in Singapore, , , , , and .

Shogakukan Asia Pte. Ltd. (Japanese: 小学館アジア Shōgakukan Asia) is an English language manga and children's book publisher based in . They are an official subsidiary of the Japanese publisher Shogakukan. Their books are available in Singapore, , , , , and .
